sentences.en: New listeners, old listeners, wherever you are in the world.

sentences.en: It is so great to have you here back for another episode as we, of course, break down the psychology of our 20s.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能回来收听新的一期节目，当然，我们要在这里剖析20多岁时的心理状态。

sentences.en: What is a more glamorous in like a uniquely non-glamorous way?
sentences.zh: 有什么是以一种极其独特且毫无光鲜可言的方式却又十分迷人的呢？

sentences.en: What is a more quintessential, chaotic, but wonderful 20-something experience than solo traveling?
sentences.zh: 还有什么比独自旅行更能代表20多岁时那标志性、混乱却又精彩的体验呢？

sentences.en: Packing everything up for a few weeks, maybe a few months, a year, and just exploring the world by yourself, backpacking across Europe, going to Bali for a month to do yoga,
sentences.zh: 收拾好行囊出发几个星期，也许几个月，甚至一年，独自一人去探索世界，在欧洲背包旅行，去巴厘岛待上一个月练瑜伽，

sentences.en: catching like a last minute train to the other side of the country or a flight to the other side of the world to find yourself, to find memories, to test yourself.
sentences.zh: 或者说走就走，搭乘最后一班列车去往国家另一端，或是坐飞机飞到世界的另一头，去寻找自我，留下回忆，挑战自我。

sentences.en: Solo traveling just feels like this really important thing that we need to do in our 20s, almost like a rite of passage, I would say.
sentences.zh: 独自旅行感觉就像是我们在20多岁时必须经历的一件极其重要的事情，我甚至觉得它就像是一个成人的仪式。

sentences.en: I will meet some of the most incredible, independent, self-assured 20-something year olds, and I can just tell they have solo traveled.
sentences.zh: 我会遇到一些最不可思议、独立且自信的二十几岁的年轻人，我一眼就能看出他们曾经独自旅行过。

sentences.en: I can just tell that they know exactly who they are more than most of us because they have had this very unique, important experience of having to truly trust themselves,
sentences.zh: 我一眼就能看出他们比大多数人更清楚自己是谁，因为他们有过这种非常独特、重要的经历——必须真正地信任自己，

sentences.en: of knowing that there is no one else in that moment who can make a decision for them, who can be their constant company, who can help them in certain situations.
sentences.zh: 明白在那个时刻没有人能为他们做决定，没有人能一直陪在他们身边，也没有人能在某些特定情况下帮到他们。

sentences.en: It is this like entirely self-directed and at times scary situation that is also equally magnificent.
sentences.zh: 这是一种完全由自己主导、有时甚至令人害怕，但同时也同样壮丽的体验。

sentences.en: And I've heard from so many of you, our wonderful listeners, who basically credit solo traveling with transforming their identity and their personality during this decade,
sentences.zh: 我听许多优秀的听众朋友说过，他们将自己在这一十年里身份和个性的蜕变，归功于独自旅行，

sentences.en: especially at very pivotal points, you know, post-breakup, post-graduation, between jobs.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在那些非常关键的节点，你知道的，比如刚分手、刚毕业、正处于职业空窗期时。

sentences.en: A lot more of us are using travel and doing it on our own to really be this experience that brings us into a new chapter of our lives.
sentences.zh: 我们当中有越来越多的人开始选择旅行，并且是独自一人去旅行，让这段经历真正带领我们迈入人生的新篇章。

sentences.en: And it's just absolutely remarkable.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是极其了不起的。

sentences.en: I am such a big advocate for doing this.
sentences.zh: 我非常支持大家去尝试这个。

sentences.en: You know, when I was 20, I solo traveled to Europe from Australia and just spent hours walking around to different sites and churches and getting loSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当我20岁的时候，我从澳大利亚独自去欧洲旅行，花了几个小时在不同的景点和教堂周围闲逛，然后迷路了。

sentences.en: I actually remember back then, I had like an iPhone 10 or like an iPhone 11, and I didn't want to pay for a data plan.
sentences.zh: 我还记得那时候，我用的是iPhone 10还是iPhone 11来着，我不想花钱买流量套餐。

sentences.en: So when I was at my hostel with Wi-Fi, I would literally point my phone in the direction that I would want to go.
sentences.zh: 所以每当我在有Wi-Fi的青旅时，我真的会拿着手机指向我想要前进的方向。

sentences.en: And I kid you not, I would be like, OK, where is the sun right now?
sentences.zh: 不瞒你说，我会想：好吧，现在太阳在哪里？

sentences.en: Is the sun behind me?
sentences.zh: 太阳在我的身后吗？

sentences.en: Like when I'm pointing in this direction, is the sun to my left, to my right?
sentences.zh: 就像当我指向这个方向时，太阳是在我的左边还是右边？

sentences.en: As long as the sun remains in that position, I can just keep walking in that way and I'll find myself getting there.
sentences.zh: 只要太阳保持在那个位置，我就可以一直朝那个方向走，然后我就能找到目的地。

sentences.en: And of course, you know, I would get loSt.
sentences.zh: 当然啦，你知道的，我还是会迷路。

sentences.en: I would never really know where I was going, to be completely honest, until I stumbled into a McDonald's with Wi-Fi.
sentences.zh: 说实话，在误打误撞走进一家有Wi-Fi的麦当劳之前，我根本不知道自己要去哪里。

sentences.en: But it was just such a beautiful experience.
sentences.zh: 但那真是一段无比美好的经历。

sentences.en: And I really learned to be confident and self-directed.
sentences.zh: 我真正学会了自信和独立主见。

sentences.en: I watched the sunrise in Amsterdam.
sentences.zh: 我在阿姆斯特丹看日出。

sentences.en: I had dinner with strangers.
sentences.zh: 我和陌生人共进晚餐。

sentences.en: I got a tattoo and then I got another one.
sentences.zh: 我纹了一个身，接着又纹了一个。

sentences.en: And those are the kinds of memories that you tell your children or you tell your friends in the nursing home.
sentences.zh: 这些就是你会讲给孩子们听，或者在养老院里讲给朋友们听的回忆。

sentences.en: They are the ones that form the foundation for our life.
sentences.zh: 正是这些回忆构成了我们人生的基石。

sentences.en: One big misconception that I really want to address is that solo traveling does have to be this huge multi-week, multi-month, multi-location expensive trip.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想澄清一个巨大的误解，那就是独自旅行不一定非得是那种为期数周、跨越多月、涉及多地且花费高昂的宏大旅行。

sentences.en: And I don't think it has to be.
sentences.zh: 我觉得完全没必要这样。

sentences.en: It can be as simple as a weekend away by yourself or a camping trip just to, you know, two hours away.
sentences.zh: 它可以很简单，比如一个人度过一个周末，或者仅仅是去两小时车程外的露营之旅。

sentences.en: That is something that I also have loved doing, you know, packing up my tent in my car and just spending three days alone by myself to clear my mind.
sentences.zh: 这也是我很喜欢做的事情，你知道的，把帐篷塞进车里，独自一人花三天时间来清空思绪。

sentences.en: My cousin was recently texting me like a couple of days ago, actually, about a solo camping trip that she did only two hours away from home for only like 48 hours.
sentences.zh: 其实就在几天前，我表妹还给我发信息，说她去了一趟离家只有两小时车程、仅仅待了48小时的独自露营之旅。

sentences.en: And even in that short span of time, she was like, this is amazing.
sentences.zh: 哪怕是在那么短的时间里，她也直呼：这太棒了。

sentences.en: I feel so liberated.
sentences.zh: 我感觉太解放了。

sentences.en: I feel so free.
sentences.zh: 我感觉太自由了。

sentences.en: I just think there are so many other ways to experience the joy and the gift that solo traveling has without breaking the bank, without feeling, you know, really,
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，有很多其他的方法可以体验到独自旅行带来的快乐和馈赠，而无需倾家荡产，也不用一开始就让自己感到

sentences.en: really out of your comfort zone to begin with.
sentences.zh: 极度不适或超出舒适区。

sentences.en: It's definitely something that needs to be, I think, talked about more instead of this glamorous, luxurious, often expensive rite of passage.
sentences.zh: 我认为这绝对是一个需要被更多讨论的话题，而不是把它包装成一种光鲜亮丽、奢侈且往往昂贵的成人礼。

sentences.en: You can literally do it in your own neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 你完全可以在自己熟悉的社区里做到这一点。

sentences.en: And I think people, because of that, but also just because of the wider accessibility of travel, are really picking it up, especially post-COVID as well.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，加之旅行变得越来越便利，人们真的开始纷纷尝试，尤其是疫情之后更是如此。

sentences.en: I think a lot of us are not so keen to wait until someone else is ready to do the things we want to do.
sentences.zh: 我想我们中的很多人都不愿再苦苦等待别人准备好，才去做我们想做的事情。

sentences.en: A lot of us have realized that if you wait and you wait and you wait until the time is right, until you have company, you know, a pandemic could begin.
sentences.zh: 我们中的很多人都已经意识到，如果你一直等、一直等、一直等到时机完全成熟、等到有人陪伴，说不定一场大流行病就要爆发了。

sentences.en: Things can get in the way and you're going to miss the opportunity.
sentences.zh: 各种意外会横亘在中间，而你将错失良机。

sentences.en: There was actually a 42% increase in people taking solo trips over the past two years.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在过去两年里，独自出行的人数增长了42%。

sentences.en: And, you know, now solo travelers, according to this really amazing research done by solo travel statistics, because, of course, there are people who are measuring this,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，根据独行旅游统计数据这一极其专业的调研显示（因为确实有人在做这方面的统计），

sentences.en: solo travelers make up 11% of the overall total market.
sentences.zh: 独行旅行者占了整体旅游市场总额的11%。

sentences.en: And 84% of those solo travelers are women.
sentences.zh: 在这些独自旅行的人中，有84%是女性。

sentences.en: So it's likely that if you go out looking for adventure in a foreign country or, you know, just up the coast, you will find other people similar to you doing the same thing,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你去异国他乡寻找冒险，或者仅仅是去海岸线上走走，你很可能会遇到和你一样做着同样事情的人，

sentences.en: looking for something, wanting it to be self-directed, no longer wanting to wait until someone else will raise their hand and say, yeah, okay, I'll come with you.
sentences.zh: 他们也在寻找某些东西，希望一切由自己主导，不再愿意苦等别人举手说：好吧，我跟你一起去。

sentences.en: So today I want to talk about this increasingly common experience, the psychology of solo traveling and how uniquely beneficial it can be to us during our 20s.
sentences.zh: 所以今天我想聊聊这个日益普遍的现象——独自旅行的心理学，以及它在我们20多岁时能带来多么独特而有益的帮助。

sentences.en: There will definitely be hard times, there will be lonely times, but we also get to experience this freedom.
sentences.zh: 期间肯定会有艰难的时刻，也会有孤独的时刻，但我们同样能体验到这种自由。

sentences.en: We get to experience this unique sense of, I don't know what the right word is, liberation, transformation.
sentences.zh: 我们能体验到这种独特的感觉，我不知道该用什么词来形容，或许是解放，是蜕变。

sentences.en: I think it's only when you're in those moments and you're experiencing it that you're, you almost become addicted to the sensation.
sentences.zh: 我想，只有当你身处那些时刻并亲自经历时，你才会几乎对这种感觉上瘾。

sentences.en: And it seems like a lot of us are.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来我们当中有很多人确实如此。

sentences.en: I also want to talk about some of the unique challenges that you might encounter, but psychologically how to overcome them and what happens when we return home.
sentences.zh: 我还想聊聊你可能会遇到的一些独特挑战，在心理上该如何克服它们，以及当我们返回家中时会发生什么。

sentences.en: What happens when the solo traveler is called back off the road?
sentences.zh: 当独自旅行者被召唤离开旅途回到现实时，会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: There is so much to discuss in this.
sentences.zh: 这里面有太多值得探讨的内容了。

sentences.en: This topic is so much deeper than you can imagine.
sentences.zh: 这个话题远比你想象的要深奥得多。

sentences.en: I've been approaching my health really differently this year.
sentences.zh: 今年我对待健康的方式有了很大的不同。

sentences.en: I used to be really focused on maximizing and doing more.
sentences.zh: 我过去总是执着于追求极限和做更多的事情。

sentences.en: And now I'm just realizing that if I listen to what my body needs, I perform way better.
sentences.zh: 而现在我渐渐明白，如果我倾听身体的需求，我的表现反而会好得多。

sentences.en: And that's why I am obsessed with my Whoop.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我对我的Whoop手环爱不释手。

sentences.en: Truly, you guys, you know I'm such a data and information driven person.
sentences.zh: 真的，大家伙儿，你们知道我是一个非常看重数据和信息的人。

sentences.en: And I love opening my Whoop app and seeing how my sleep, my stress, my strain is correlating with my mood, with my running performance, with how I'm just feeling day to day.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢打开Whoop应用，查看我的睡眠、压力、身体负荷是如何与我的情绪、跑步表现以及日常状态相互关联的。

sentences.en: I'm not an elite athlete by any means, but I do really benefit.
sentences.zh: 我绝不是什么顶尖运动员，但我确实从中获益良多。

sentences.en: And I also just really enjoy knowing more about my body.
sentences.zh: 而且我也真的很享受深入了解自己的身体。

sentences.en: And Whoop also gives me these actionable,
sentences.zh: Whoop还为我提供这些可操作的、

sentences.en: personalized insights that have made me more intentional and meant that I make smarter decisions day to day about what I need rather than just putting my foot on the gas and just going,
sentences.zh: 个性化的洞察，让我变得更有意识，这意味着我在日常生活中能根据自身需求做出更明智的决定，而不是只知道把油门踩到底，一味地

sentences.en: going, going, going, going.
sentences.zh: 冲、冲、冲、冲、冲。

sentences.en: New members can try Whoop with a 30-day free trial before committing to a membership.
sentences.zh: 新会员在正式订购前可免费试用Whoop 30天。

sentences.en: That's join.whoop.com slash psychology for your free month of Whoop.
sentences.zh: 访问 join.whoop.com slash psychology 即可免费体验一个月的Whoop。

sentences.en: A lot of us feel deeply drawn to solo travel specifically, I think because of how sacred it feels.
sentences.zh: 我们当中的很多人之所以对独自旅行有着深深的向往，我想主要是因为它感觉如此神圣。

sentences.en: And that's how I would describe it.
sentences.zh: 这也是我所倾向的描述。

sentences.en: There is, as I said before, almost a rite of passage feeling that is attached to this equally scary but ultimately rewarding experience.
sentences.zh: 正如我之前所说，这种体验带有一种几乎像是成人礼的感觉，它既令人畏惧，但最终又回报丰厚。

sentences.en: How often in our lives do we actually ever get the opportunity to be truly alone, to be truly dependent on ourselves for everything?
sentences.zh: 在我们的一生中，到底有多少次真正有机会能够彻底独处，在所有事情上都真正依靠自己？

sentences.en: You know, how often are we actually able to call most of the shots in our life?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们究竟有多少次能够自己做主生活中的大部分事情？

sentences.en: Most of us, myself included, I would say, we are constantly surrounded by friends, family, loved ones, colleagues.
sentences.zh: 我想我们大多数人，包括我自己，都时刻被朋友、家人、挚爱和同事包围着。

sentences.en: And we also are in a very comfortable environment that is familiar and that is really easy to navigate.
sentences.zh: 而且我们还身处一个非常舒适、熟悉且很容易适应的环境中。

sentences.en: But solo travel really throws all of that up in the air.
sentences.zh: 但独自旅行彻底打破了这一切。

sentences.en: Firstly, you're in a place that you don't necessarily know when you solo travel.
sentences.zh: 首先，当你独自旅行时，你往往身处一个并不太熟悉的地方。

sentences.en: Then you remove your support network.
sentences.zh: 接着，你剥离了你的支持网络。

sentences.en: Then you might add in, you know, a language that you don't speak.
sentences.zh: 然后，你可能还要应对一种你不会说的语言。

sentences.en: But also with that, there is an excitement.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，其中也伴随着一种兴奋。

sentences.en: There is this unlimited possibility of what's tomorrow going to bring?
sentences.zh: 那就是对明天会带来什么的无限可能。

sentences.en: What am I going to choose to do?
sentences.zh: 我接下来要选择做什么？

sentences.en: It's novel.
sentences.zh: 这是新奇的。

sentences.en: It's scary.
sentences.zh: 这也是让人害怕的。

sentences.en: And when was the last time that you actually felt that way in your current routine?
sentences.zh: 而你上一次在日常生活中真正有这种感觉是什么时候？

sentences.en: So what is it about solo traveling that is so alluring other than what I have just described?
sentences.zh: 那么，除了我刚才所说的之外，独自旅行究竟有什么如此吸引人的地方？

sentences.en: Well, there was a 2015 report from the International Journal for Tourism Research that looked into this.
sentences.zh: 国际旅游研究杂志（International Journal for Tourism Research）在2015年有一份报告探讨了这个问题。

sentences.en: It wanted to know why are people suddenly so drawn to this experience?
sentences.zh: 它想知道为什么人们突然对这种体验如此着迷？

sentences.en: And what it found was that the majority of solo travelers are motivated by one of the following things.
sentences.zh: 研究发现，大多数独自旅行者都是受以下某一种原因驱使。

sentences.en: They are motivated by the need for a feeling of freedom, by a desire to escape or a desire to find themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们是出于对自由感的追求、对逃避的渴望，或是为了寻找自我。

sentences.en: So feelings of freedom, a desire to escape or a desire to find ourselves, which honestly all sound like pretty much the same thing wrapped into one.
sentences.zh: 所以，对自由感的追求、对逃避的渴望或是寻找自我，说实话，这些听起来都像是把同一件事包裹在了一起。

sentences.en: There was another study from 2021 that found something very, very similar.
sentences.zh: 2021年的另一项研究也发现了非常非常相似的结果。

sentences.en: When this researcher interviewed a number of people who were solo travelers, who had solo traveled in the past year or two, what they said motivated them was very similar.
sentences.zh: 当这位研究人员采访了许多在过去一两年里独自旅行过的人时，他们所说的动机都非常相似。

sentences.en: But besides those previous inspirational, motivational actions, besides those previous intentions, they also said that it was the flexibility.
sentences.zh: 但除了前面那些鼓舞人心的行动动机、除了之前那些出游意图之外，他们还提到了灵活性。

sentences.en: It was the promise of a transformative experience and this anticipated self-discovery that was really, really motivating.
sentences.zh: 正是这种变革性体验的承诺以及对自我发现的期待，带来了非常非常大的动力。

sentences.en: So maybe you can relate to that with your own solo travel ambitions.
sentences.zh: 所以，也许你能在自己独自旅行的宏伟计划中找到共鸣。

sentences.en: We are seeking out the promise of knowing ourselves better.
sentences.zh: 我们正在探寻更深刻地认识自我的承诺。

sentences.en: And this is particularly influential after you've just been through something really tough or life changing, like a breakup, for example,
sentences.zh: 在你刚经历了一些非常艰难或改变人生的大事之后，这种影响尤其深远，比如刚分手，

sentences.en: or you've just been made redundant or you've graduated.
sentences.zh: 或者你刚被裁员，又或是刚毕业。

sentences.en: You are, I think, particularly poised for growth at that moment.
sentences.zh: 我认为，在那个时刻，你特别蓄势待发，准备迎来成长。

sentences.en: And travel really, really brings that out.
sentences.zh: 而旅行确实非常非常能激发这一点。

sentences.en: I think that it's actually really important to do after one of those moments.
sentences.zh: 我认为在经历这些时刻之后去旅行实际上非常重要。

sentences.en: You can't just go back to, you know, living an everyday life.
sentences.zh: 你不能只是回到，你知道的，日复一日的生活中去。

sentences.en: After you graduate, you know that normalcy is gone.
sentences.zh: 毕业后，你知道那种正常的生活状态已经一去不复返了。

sentences.en: After your breakup, after you've been made redundant, everything about your current everyday reality has shifted.
sentences.zh: 在你经历分手、被裁员之后，你当前日常现实的一切都发生了转变。

sentences.en: And I think giving yourself time to go on solo travel through that allows you to kind of jump into the next chapter of whatever life is going to bring you, being more confident,
sentences.zh: 我认为，让自己有时间在经历这些时去独自旅行，能让你更有信心地跃入生活带给你的下一个章节，

sentences.en: being more self-assured, genuinely just knowing what you want and knowing how to speak about that, knowing how to say that.
sentences.zh: 变得更加自信，真正清楚自己想要什么，并且懂得如何去表达这一点，如何把它说出来。

sentences.en: Some of us do have more of a propensity for solo travel than others, and it's actually influenced by this personality trait called an openness to experience.
sentences.zh: 我们当中有些人确实比其他人更有独自旅行的倾向，这其实受一种被称为“经验开放性”的人格特质影响。

sentences.en: I don't think that's a surprise, but you might be familiar with this trait.
sentences.zh: 我想这并不令人意外，但你可能对这个特质很熟悉。

sentences.en: It's one of the big five personality traits.
sentences.zh: 它是人格大五特质之一。

sentences.en: And if you are someone who measures high on this characteristic, on this openness to experience, you are typically more curious.
sentences.zh: 如果你在这个特征、在这个经验开放性上得分很高，你通常会更有好奇心。

sentences.en: You are more independent, adaptable, willing to try new ideas, new values, new emotions, new experiences, and you are more adventurous.
sentences.zh: 你更加独立、适应力强，愿意尝试新的想法、新的价值观念、新的情绪、新的体验，并且更具冒险精神。

sentences.en: So this openness to experience combined with something that we call high self-efficacy,
sentences.zh: 因此，这种对经验的开放性与我们所说的“高自我效能感”结合在一起，

sentences.en: which basically refers to our belief in our ability to influence our reality and to influence the outcomes that we would like.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是指我们坚信自己有能力影响现实，并影响我们期望的结果。

sentences.en: Those two things essentially allow us to really trust in our agency, but also to feel quite passionate about having these experiences, and it makes for the ideal solo traveler.
sentences.zh: 这两点本质上让我们能够真正信任自己的自主权，同时也对拥有这些体验感到相当热情，这造就了理想的独自旅行者。

sentences.en: I will say the final big reason I personally like solo traveling that isn't, you know, related to finding yourself, that isn't related to an openness to experience,
sentences.zh: 我得说，我自己喜欢独自旅行的最后一个重大原因，其实与寻找自我无关，与经验开放性也无关，

sentences.en: and it might sound selfish, but it's basically just that you don't have to consider other people in your plans.
sentences.zh: 听起来可能有点自私，但基本上就是你不需要在计划中顾及其他人。

sentences.en: And if you are someone who is very hyper-independent, maybe even impatient like I am at times, that can be such a big factor in what is influencing us to solo travel.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个极度独立、甚至有时像我一样缺乏耐心的人，这会成为促使我们独自旅行的一个巨大因素。

sentences.en: I am already someone who finds travel to be kind of anxiety-inducing, you know, I have fun, I love it once I get there, but I do find like I do need to go at my own pace,
sentences.zh: 我本身就是那种觉得旅行有点引发焦虑的人，你知道的，我玩得很开心，一旦到了目的地我也很享受，但我确实觉得我需要按自己的节奏前进，

sentences.en: my own speed.
sentences.zh: 按我自己的速度。

sentences.en: I want to see things that other people might not, and sometimes I like to go back to the same places.
sentences.zh: 我想看别人可能不会看的风景，有时我喜欢故地重游。

sentences.en: I'm a very particular kind of traveler, and I appreciate that I'm also quite indulgent, and that might be like indulgent with my time.
sentences.zh: 我是一个非常挑剔的旅行者，我也承认自己有点任性，这可能体现在我对待时间的随性上。

sentences.en: Like, I want to go slow, I want to just really bask in the experiences, and that's probably annoying for people to travel with,
sentences.zh: 比如，我想慢下来，只想真正沉浸在体验中，和别人一起旅行的话，这可能会让人觉得很烦，

sentences.en: but it also means that people who travel differently to me, I find it kind of frustrating sometimes, having to compromise for something that is so uniquely, like,
sentences.zh: 但这也意味着，对于那些旅行方式与我不同的人，我有时会觉得挺沮丧的，因为不得不去妥协，而旅行明明是如此独特的一场……

sentences.en: traveling is a selfish experience.
sentences.zh: 旅行是一种自私的体验。

sentences.en: It is a self-driven experience, you know, you've already spent all this money to get somewhere, at least coming from Australia,
sentences.zh: 它是一种自我驱动的体验，你知道的，你已经花了这么多钱去某个地方，至少从澳大利亚出发是这样，

sentences.en: if I want to go to Europe or Africa or North America, it's going to take me at least 15 to 24 hours, and it's going to cost me a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 如果我想去欧洲、非洲或北美，至少要花15到24个小时，而且还要花掉我一大笔钱。

sentences.en: So, once I get there,
sentences.zh: 所以，一旦我到了那里，

sentences.en: it's kind of like I don't want to have to consult a group of friends or every single member of my family anytime I want to eat or book accommodation or spontaneously change my plans,
sentences.zh: 我可不想每当我想吃饭、订住宿或者临时改变计划时，还得去征求一群朋友或家里每个成员的意见，

sentences.en: and I think that's really sometimes another really valuable thing to consider.
sentences.zh: 我觉得有时候这确实是另一个非常值得考虑的宝贵之处。

sentences.en: But, like, if this is such a personal, and I know I said selfish, but personal experience, sometimes you don't want to share it with someone else.
sentences.zh: 但是，如果这是一个如此私密——我知道我刚才说过自私，但这就是个私密体验——有时候你就是不想跟别人分享。

sentences.en: This actually brings up a memory I have, not even a memory, basically when I was 15, I went to New York with my family for Christmas because my mom is American,
sentences.zh: 这其实让我想起了一段记忆，甚至算不上记忆，基本上就是当我15岁的时候，我和家人去纽约过圣诞节，因为我妈妈是美国人，

sentences.en: and we were kind of visiting some of her family as well.
sentences.zh: 我们当时也顺便去拜访了她的一些家人。

sentences.en: And I was a very avid journaler at the time, I had, I wrote a journal entry every single night,
sentences.zh: 我当时是个非常热爱写日记的人，我每天晚上都会写一篇日记，

sentences.en: and recently I was looking back through my old journals from that time because I was just doing some reminiscing with my book being announced, and I found an entry from that time,
sentences.zh: 最近我翻看了当年那些旧日记，因为随着我的书即将官宣，我一直在追忆往昔，结果我找到了当时的一篇日记，

sentences.en: and it said in all caps, quote, You do not like traveling with other people.
sentences.zh: 上面全是大写字母写着，原话是：你根本不喜欢和别人一起旅行。

sentences.en: Do not do this again.
sentences.zh: 不要再这么做了。

sentences.en: When you become an adult, do not travel with other people.
sentences.zh: 等你长大了，千万别和别人一起旅行。

sentences.en: And I just had to laugh about it.
sentences.zh: 我看完忍不住笑了。

sentences.en: I was like, that is so funny that 15-year-old Gemma already kind of knew what was up.
sentences.zh: 心想，15岁的杰玛（Gemma）就已经看透这一切了，这真的太好玩了。

sentences.en: I, like, showed it to my boyfriend, and he was like, yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 我把它拿给我的男朋友看，他看了直说，没错，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: Like, even when we travel together, I need my days to just go and do my own thing.
sentences.zh: 就像哪怕我们一起旅行，我也需要有几天时间去过我自己的生活，做我自己的事。

sentences.en: Same with when I travel with my friends.
sentences.zh: 我和朋友旅行时也是如此。

sentences.en: It's not like I don't like doing it, but I definitely need that solo space within that.
sentences.zh: 倒不是说我讨厌这样，但我绝对需要在其中拥有那种独处空间。

sentences.en: And this really brings me to my first major point as to why solo traveling is so valuable to do during your 20s, and it's that it makes you confident in your own choices,
sentences.zh: 这真的让我谈到了我的第一个主要观点，即为什么在二十多岁时独自旅行如此宝贵，那就是它能让你对自己的选择充满自信，

sentences.en: and it really ensures that you get to prioritize the experiences that you want to have.
sentences.zh: 并且它真的能确保你优先体验到你真正想过的生活。

sentences.en: If you are someone who is, for example, you know, maybe a people pleaser, that experience of getting to prioritize what you want to do can be so liberating.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个，比如说，有些讨好型人格的人，那种能够优先做自己想做的事情的体验会是如此的解放身心。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's like one of the first times that we've ever been allowed to just, and we've ever given ourselves permission, I guess,
sentences.zh: 有时这就像是我们第一次被允许，我想我们也是第一次给予自己许可，

sentences.en: to just do what best suits us without having to carry the burden of thinking about other people's preferences.
sentences.zh: 去只做最适合自己的事，而不必背负考虑他人喜好的沉重负担。

sentences.en: It can almost bring you to tears sometimes, you know, getting to eat lunch when you want, watching the sunset on a random day because you want to.
sentences.zh: 有时甚至能让你感动得流泪，你知道的，想什么时候吃午饭就什么时候吃，因为你想看就在某个平常的日子去看日落。

sentences.en: It's like the weight of always considering what would make other people happy and having to juggle all of their contradictory preferences is gone.
sentences.zh: 就好像那种时刻顾及怎样才能让别人开心、不得不权衡他们所有矛盾喜好的沉重包袱终于消失了。

sentences.en: The burden is really lifted.
sentences.zh: 负担真的卸下了。

sentences.en: And I think you'll be surprised to see how much your relationship with yourself improves as a result of this.
sentences.zh: 我想你会惊讶地发现，因此你与自己的关系竟然改善了这么多。

sentences.en: Suddenly, you really learn to listen to yourself.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，你真正学会了倾听自己的声音。

sentences.en: You know what it feels like to just have it your way, and that feels really fucking good.
sentences.zh: 你知道了按照自己的心愿行事是什么感觉，那感觉简直爽呆了。

sentences.en: I think that is why women especially find a lot of freedom in solo travel,
sentences.zh: 我想这就是为什么女性尤其能在独自旅行中找到很多自由，

sentences.en: especially if you're an eldest daughter or came from a large family or felt a lot of expectations from your parents when you were younger.
sentences.zh: 特别是如果你是家里的大女儿，或者来自一个大家庭，又或者在年轻时背负了父母太多的期望。

sentences.en: Solo traveling is this unique space where you are actually rewarded for knowing what you want and doing it.
sentences.zh: 独自旅行提供了一个独特的空间，在这里，你知道自己想要什么并付诸行动，实际上会得到回报。

sentences.en: And isn't that so contradictory to, you know, the childhood environments and the teenage environments that we were raised in?
sentences.zh: 这难道不与我们成长的童年环境和青春期环境形成了巨大的反差吗？

sentences.en: In fact, you know, to bring another psychology study into the mix, because we can never have too many.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你知道的，再引入另一个心理学研究，因为研究永远不嫌多。

sentences.en: There was a paper from 2023, so last year,
sentences.zh: 2023年有一篇论文，也就是去年的研究，

sentences.en: that found that traveling alone means you actually experience the sensations and the moments of your trip more deeply because you are less distracted by a second person.
sentences.zh: 发现独自旅行意味着你实际上能更深刻地体验到旅行中的感官和时刻，因为你受第二个人的干扰更少。

sentences.en: You actually have the chance to meet new people, chat to new people, pay attention to the small things, you know, as you walk the streets, you are naturally more aware,
sentences.zh: 你实际上有机会结识新朋友、和新朋友聊天、留意微小的事物，你知道的，当你漫步街头时，你会自然而然地更有觉察力，

sentences.en: both from a safety perspective.
sentences.zh: 既是从安全的角度出发。

sentences.en: But I think that with that awareness, it brings more moments of noticing and that in itself, the necessity of being more aware of your surroundings.
sentences.zh: 但我认为随着这种觉察力的提升，会带来更多被注意到的瞬间，而这种觉察力本身——即更加留意周围环境的必要性——

sentences.en: It really promotes being present, which is really fantastic for the emotional and mental experience that we get from traveling.
sentences.zh: 真正促进了“活在当下”，这对于我们从旅行中获得的感官和心理体验来说实在是太棒了。

sentences.en: We also know that this experience really allows you to prove to yourself that you can do hard things, things that you never really imagined yourself doing.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道，这种经历确实能向你自己证明，你可以完成艰难的事情，完成那些你从未真正想象过自己能做到的事情。

sentences.en: Let me tell you a story about how I had this very experience, this very realization that I was a lot tougher and smarter than I thought I was because of solo traveling.
sentences.zh: 让我给你讲个故事，讲讲我是如何有这种独特经历的：因为独自旅行，我突然意识到自己比想象中要坚强和聪明得多。

sentences.en: So one uni break, I was traveling somewhere and I can't even remember specifically where I was traveling to because I was coming back.
sentences.zh: 所以有一次大学假期，我在某处旅行，我甚至记不清具体是去哪儿了，因为我当时正在回程途中。

sentences.en: I was returning home to Australia and I had booked, of course, you know, the cheapest flight possible.
sentences.zh: 我正在返回澳大利亚的家中，当然，我订的是最便宜的机票。

sentences.en: I remember it was like $800 return, I think to Amsterdam.
sentences.zh: 我记得往返好像是800美元，应该是去阿姆斯特丹的。

sentences.en: Actually, I was going through Amsterdam to Europe and some other places.
sentences.zh: 其实，我是经由阿姆斯特丹去欧洲和其他一些地方的。

sentences.en: So $800 return from Sydney to Amsterdam and then back.
sentences.zh: 所以从悉尼到阿姆斯特丹往返只要800美元。

sentences.en: And you have to remember, this is firstly Australian dollars.
sentences.zh: 你得记住，首先这是澳大利亚元。

sentences.en: So a lot cheaper than like the US dollar or like pounds or euros or whatever.
sentences.zh: 所以比美元、英镑或欧元之类的要便宜得多。

sentences.en: Very, very cheap at the time for a 24 hour trip.
sentences.zh: 对于一趟24小时的行程来说，当时真的很便宜很便宜。

sentences.en: Like that's how long the flight took.
sentences.zh: 就像飞行时间那么长。

sentences.en: Anyways, the catch of this cheap flight was that I had to spend 15 hours in Taiwan overnight.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，这张便宜机票的代价是我必须在台湾过夜待上15个小时。

sentences.en: And at this point, I had completely run out of money on my international card.
sentences.zh: 而此时，我国际卡里的钱已经彻底花光了。

sentences.en: I only had one $50 American bill in my shoe, like a $50 American note that my mom was like, always keep this in the bottom of your shoe just in case.
sentences.zh: 我的鞋里只塞了一张50美元的纸币，就像我妈妈叮嘱的那样：“永远把这个放在鞋底以防万一。”

sentences.en: Thank you, mom, for reminding me to do that.
sentences.zh: 谢谢妈妈提醒我这么做。

sentences.en: Well, so I'd stayed in this, I was staying in this small three room motel.
sentences.zh: 总之，我当时住在这样一个，我住在一家只有三个房间的小汽车旅馆里。

sentences.en: I couldn't stay in the airport for whatever reason.
sentences.zh: 不知出于什么原因，我不能待在机场里。

sentences.en: I had to leave the airport.
sentences.zh: 我必须离开机场。

sentences.en: So I was staying in this three room hotel motel thing and I'd paid for it before the start of my trip.
sentences.zh: 所以我就住在这个三间房的酒店汽车旅馆似的地方，而且我在旅行开始前就已经付过房费了。

sentences.en: Did not think about the fact that I would need to get a taxi to the airport and that I would need to eat dinner.
sentences.zh: 根本没想过我还需要打车去机场，还需要吃晚饭。

sentences.en: You know, this was a 15 hour layover and I didn't have any money.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这是一次15个小时的转机停留，而我身上一文不名。

sentences.en: So I remember like sneaking into, there was a wedding banquet, like someone was getting married.
sentences.zh: 所以我记得自己像是溜了进去，当时正好有一场婚宴，有人在结婚。

sentences.en: There were so many people there and they had this huge array of food.
sentences.zh: 那里有好多人，他们摆了满满一大桌丰盛的食物。

sentences.en: And I was like, okay, I'm just going to sneak in.
sentences.zh: 我就想，好吧，我要直接溜进去。

sentences.en: And, you know, they're just going to think like this random white girl is here, like who invited her?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，他们只会觉得这个陌生的白人女孩怎么在这儿，是谁邀请她的？

sentences.en: But no one's going to question it.
sentences.zh: 但不会有人去盘问的。

sentences.en: I'm just going to eat some food and sneak out.
sentences.zh: 我吃点东西就溜出来。

sentences.en: And luckily that worked.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，这招还真管用。

sentences.en: I honestly think that they kind of knew and they probably just felt really sorry for me.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我觉得他们其实看出来了，可能只是非常同情我吧。

sentences.en: And then came the moment when I needed to get a taxi.
sentences.zh: 接着就到了我需要打车的时候了。

sentences.en: I had to get a taxi to the airport.
sentences.zh: 我必须打车去机场。

sentences.en: And I was kind of panicking and I'd gotten the front desk to call me a local taxi.
sentences.zh: 我当时有点恐慌，让前台帮我叫了一辆当地的出租车。

sentences.en: Had no idea how much it was going to be.
sentences.zh: 完全不知道要花多少钱。

sentences.en: Had this $50 note.
sentences.zh: 身上只有那张50美元的钞票。

sentences.en: He drops me off at the airport and I just give him the $50 American note.
sentences.zh: 他把我送到机场，我直接把那张50美元的纸币给了他。

sentences.en: No idea if it's more, less, right on, you know, if he's even going to accept it.
sentences.zh: 完全不知道这钱是多了、少了、刚刚好，也不知道他到底收不收。

sentences.en: And he kind of just looked at me and he just was like, okay.
sentences.zh: 他看了我一眼，然后说了声“好”。

sentences.en: And just took the note.
sentences.zh: 直接把钱收下了。

sentences.en: And I got my bag out of the back and he drove off.
sentences.zh: 我从后备箱拿出行李，他就开车走了。

sentences.en: And it was just the biggest sense of like relief and accomplishment.
sentences.zh: 那一刻涌现出一种巨大的解脱感和成就感。

sentences.en: That was like, okay, like I did that hard thing.
sentences.zh: 当时就觉得，好吧，我搞定了一件难事。

sentences.en: I also didn't have any internet.
sentences.zh: 我当时还没有网。

sentences.en: I had no money.
sentences.zh: 我没有钱。

sentences.en: I just had myself.
sentences.zh: 我只有我自己。

sentences.en: I couldn't call anyone.
sentences.zh: 我谁也联系不上。

sentences.en: I didn't know anyone in Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 我在台湾谁也不认识。

sentences.en: It was equally scary.
sentences.zh: 这同样让人感到害怕。

sentences.en: But also the most empowering thing to just realize that, oh, wow, I'm an adult in this situation and I figured it out.
sentences.zh: 但这也是最赋能的体验，让我意识到：哦，天哪，在这种情况下我已经是个成年人了，而且我把问题解决了。

sentences.en: And I've never felt so alone, but also so self-sufficient.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有感到如此孤独，但也从未感到如此自力更生。

sentences.en: And it's that, it's those experiences that we are all bound to have when solo traveling that are going to give you lifelong skills, such as problem solving,
sentences.zh: 正是在独自旅行中注定会经历的这些经历，会赋予你终身受益的技能，比如解决问题，

sentences.en: such as decision making.
sentences.zh: 比如做出决策。

sentences.en: I often think a lot of us get worried about solo traveling that we're going to have this like gap in our resume.
sentences.zh: 我经常觉得我们中的很多人会担心独自旅行会在简历上留下空白。

sentences.en: If I was an employer and I saw that someone in their 20s had done this huge solo traveling trip or took time off to go and explore by themselves,
sentences.zh: 但如果我是雇主，看到某个二十多岁的人有过这样一场大型的独自旅行经历，或者曾抽时间独自去探索世界，

sentences.en: they are honestly going to be at the top of my list to hire because there's just so many skills that you cannot teach, that a workplace won't teach, that a university won't teach.
sentences.zh: 他们绝对会排在我招聘名单的最前列，因为有太多技能是无法通过教授获得的，是职场教不会的，也是大学教不会的。

sentences.en: And I think life is more about just having professional experiences and also about having life experiences.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，生活不仅仅是拥有专业经验，同样也关乎拥有生活经验。

sentences.en: Those are the people who are the best to work with, the most interesting, often the most driven.
sentences.zh: 那些是最适合共事的人，最有趣，通常也最有进取心。

sentences.en: So if you ever worry, like I've taken all this time off to solo travel, everyone else is further ahead than me.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你曾经担心，就像我花了大把时间独自旅行，而其他人似乎都比我走得更远。

sentences.en: Everyone else, those people you're comparing yourself to are most likely looking at you and being like, wow, I wish that I'd actually taken time to explore and to know myself.
sentences.zh: 其他人，那些你一直在比较的对象，多半正看着你，心里想着：哇，我要是真能花时间去探索、去了解自己该多好。

sentences.en: This is why I also think that solo traveling continues to be important, even when you are in a relationship, even when you have a long-term monogamous partner.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我也认为，独自旅行依然很重要，哪怕你正处于一段恋爱中，哪怕你有一个长期稳定的伴侣。

sentences.en: Of course, you know, you want to have those moments and experiences and memories with them.
sentences.zh: 当然，你知道的，你会想要和他们一起拥有那些时刻、经历和回忆。

sentences.en: You want to travel with them.
sentences.zh: 你会想和他们一起去旅行。

sentences.en: But if you are in your 20s and you really want to go somewhere, there is a place on your bucket list that you've always wanted to visit.
sentences.zh: 但如果你正值二十多岁，真的很想去某个地方，那儿有你愿望清单上一直想去的地方。

sentences.en: You have the means, you have the time, you have the opportunity.
sentences.zh: 你有资源，你有时间，你有机会。

sentences.en: You shouldn't feel like you need to wait until someone else is ready to go with you.
sentences.zh: 你不应该觉得自己非得等到别人准备好跟你一起去。

sentences.en: You can go alone.
sentences.zh: 你可以一个人去。

sentences.en: You can do it alone.
sentences.zh: 你可以一个人完成。

sentences.en: You are not suddenly a paired item with this person, no matter what.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，你并没有突然变成这个人的附属品。

sentences.en: Especially like, not to be a cynic, but that relationship could not work.
sentences.zh: 尤其是，并非想当个愤世嫉俗的人，但那段关系可能走不下去。

sentences.en: Something could happen tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天可能会发生任何事。

sentences.en: You guys could break up next month or in the next two, three, five years.
sentences.zh: 你们下个月，或者在未来两、三年、五年内可能会分手。

sentences.en: And when you two are no longer together and the opportunity to travel has passed, there is going to be this what-if sensation.
sentences.zh: 当你们不再在一起，而旅行的机会已经错过时，就会产生这种“如果当初”的感觉。

sentences.en: This what-if surrounding the memories you could have made, the skills you could have built, the things you could have seen.
sentences.zh: 这种“如果当初”围绕着本可以创造的回忆、本可以培养的技能、本可以见识的事物。

sentences.en: And I think that, you know, a relationship is important and we do care about someone.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，你知道的，一段关系很重要，我们也确实在意某个人。

sentences.en: It doesn't mean that we need to give up all of our solo experiences and only do it with them.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着我们需要放弃所有独自体验的机会，只能和他们一起去。

sentences.en: So hopefully I've made an argument for continuing to do this.
sentences.zh: 所以希望我的这番论述能说服大家继续坚持这样做。

sentences.en: You know, maintaining your independence through solo traveling when you're in a relationship.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在恋爱中通过独自旅行来保持你的独立性。

sentences.en: It really ensures that your self-concept, this like overarching fundamental idea of who you are, that that remains very, very strong.
sentences.zh: 它确实能确保你的自我概念，也就是关于你是谁的这种宏观、核心的观念，能够保持得非常非常强大。

sentences.en: So this is a really glamorous idea of solo traveling that we've painted so far.
sentences.zh: 所以，到目前为止，我们所描绘的独自旅行是一个非常光鲜亮丽的概念。

sentences.en: One of adventure, of self-discovery, of once-in-a-lifetime moments.
sentences.zh: 一个充满冒险、自我发现、千载难逢的时刻的概念。

sentences.en: But there are also hard moments, moments of doubt and loneliness.
sentences.zh: 但其中也有艰难的时刻，充满怀疑和孤独的时刻。

sentences.en: And I think that's worth discussing.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是值得探讨的。

sentences.en: I think it would be remiss of me to just paint this picture of sunshine and rainbows and self-discovery.
sentences.zh: 如果我只把画面描绘得阳光灿烂、充满彩虹和自我发现，那就太失职了。

sentences.en: There will be hard times that we inevitably encounter.
sentences.zh: 我们不可避免地会遇到艰难的时期。

sentences.en: But we also have a lot of really deeply seated psychological tools to help us get through them.
sentences.zh: 但我们也拥有许多根深蒂固的心理工具来帮助我们度过难关。

sentences.en: So we're going to talk about that and so much more along with what happens when we return home.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要聊聊这个，以及更多内容，还有当我们回到家时会发生什么。

sentences.zh: 什么是独自旅行后遗症？

sentences.en: And I love opening my WHOOP app and seeing how my sleep, my stress, my strain is correlating with my mood, with my running performance, with how I'm just feeling day to day.

sentences.en: I'm not an elite athlete by any means, but I do really benefit.

sentences.en: And I also just really enjoy knowing more about my body.
sentences.zh: 而且我也真的很喜欢多了解一些关于自己身体的信息。

sentences.en: And WHOOP also gives me these actionable, personalized insights that have made me more intentional and meant that I make smarter decisions day to day about what I need rather

sentences.en: Doing anything alone can be tough, even when it has its perks.

sentences.en: You know, people who solo travel a lot in their 20s, they will most likely tell you how rewarding it is.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那些在二十多岁时经常独自旅行的人，多半会告诉你这有多么值得。

sentences.en: But if you dig a little deeper, some of the other things they may tell you to essentially
sentences.zh: 但如果你深入挖掘，他们可能会告诉你需要做好的其他准备还包括

sentences.en: be prepared for is the loneliness, the decision fatigue, the exhaustion, the fear of the unknown, maybe safety concerns, wanting to come home early.
sentences.zh: 孤独感、决策疲劳、精疲力竭、对未知的恐惧、对安全的担忧，以及想要提前回家的念头。

sentences.en: And also, I think the pressure for personal growth.
sentences.zh: 还有，我认为，来自个人成长的压力。

sentences.en: You feel like if you're solo traveling, you can't just have a normal trip.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得如果自己独自旅行，就不能只来一次普通的旅行。

sentences.en: There has to be some greater personal development goal that you are striving towards, some epiphany
sentences.zh: 这里面必须包含某种你在努力追求的更宏大的个人发展目标，某种在返回家乡前必须获得的顿悟，

sentences.en: that needs to be had before you return home so that you can come home a changed person.
sentences.zh: 好让你能以一个改变了的面貌回到家中。

sentences.en: So it doesn't sound like a challenge, but I think it kind of is because it influences the mindset that we bring into the trip.
sentences.zh: 所以这听起来可能不算什么挑战，但我认为它其实算，因为它会影响我们带进旅途中的心态。

sentences.en: Let's walk through some of these challenges and how to feel more confident addressing them.
sentences.zh: 让我们来探讨一下其中一些挑战，以及如何更有信心地应对它们。

sentences.en: Something that has always been comforting to me is that there have been thousands of people
sentences.zh: 一直以来给我带来安慰的一点是，在我之前有成千上万的人

sentences.en: before me in this exact experience who have experienced the same sensations, the same anxieties and worries, and they've pushed through.
sentences.zh: 经历过这完全相同的体验，经历过相同的感受、相同的焦虑和担忧，而他们都挺过来了。

sentences.en: They've always come back with more good stories than bad.
sentences.zh: 他们带回的好故事总是比坏故事多。

sentences.en: And also, you know, the best place to grow is right when you start feeling a little bit uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道的，最佳的成长时机正是当你开始感到有点不自在的时候。

sentences.en: You don't need to be so insanely uncomfortable that you want to leave, but a bit of discomfort, that's really stretching you as a person.
sentences.zh: 你不需要感到极其不适以至于想要离开，但有一点不适感，那确实能作为一个人在扩展你的边界。

sentences.en: And with that stretch, you grow, you know, without tension, without friction, nothing will ever challenge you.
sentences.zh: 伴随着这种扩展，你成长了，你知道的，没有压力，没有摩擦，没有什么能真正挑战你。

sentences.en: So I think the biggest thing that we are going to confront that will challenge us is loneliness.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们要面对的、将挑战我们的最大事情就是孤独感。

sentences.en: Without the companionship of friends or family, I think we feel quite isolated, especially in
sentences.zh: 没有朋友或家人的陪伴，我认为我们会感到相当孤立，尤其是在

sentences.en: an unfamiliar environment when we don't even have those kind of small creature comforts.
sentences.zh: 一个陌生的环境中，当我们甚至没有那些日常的小确幸时。

sentences.en: There are definitely many times when you think it would be really nice to share this with someone.
sentences.zh: 肯定有很多次，你会觉得如果能和某人分享这一切该多好。

sentences.en: Or you go to sleep at the end of the day and you realize like, huh, I haven't actually said a word to anyone else this entire day.
sentences.zh: 或者你在一天结束时上床睡觉，然后意识到，哈，这一整天我其实都没和任何人说过一句话。

sentences.en: And it feels definitely very odd.
sentences.zh: 这种感觉绝对非常奇妙而怪异。

sentences.en: But the loneliness can also be a really sacred and special element of this experience.
sentences.zh: 但孤独感也可以是这段经历中非常神圣和特殊的一个元素。

sentences.en: For one, it's definitely the price you pay for more freedom.
sentences.zh: 首先，这绝对是你为了获得更多自由而付出的代价。

sentences.en: But additionally, you know, you get to really zone in on your inner world.
sentences.zh: 此外，你知道的，你可以真正专注于你的内心世界。

sentences.en: There was a study done that assessed the importance of having this kind of alone time, not just when traveling, but in your everyday life.
sentences.zh: 曾有一项研究评估了拥有这种独处时间的重要性，不仅是在旅行时，在你的日常生活中也是如此。

sentences.en: And it assessed a sample of 150 people.
sentences.zh: 它评估了150人的样本。

sentences.en: And what it did was it asked them to prioritize spending an hour alone for three weeks, only three weeks, an hour every day.
sentences.zh: 它的做法是要求他们优先安排连续三周每天花一小时独处，仅仅三周，每天一小时。

sentences.en: So those who did this, those who went through with it, they felt so much more introspective.
sentences.zh: 所以那些做到这一点的人，那些坚持下来的人，他们感到内省了许多。

sentences.en: They actually had more social energy.
sentences.zh: 他们的社交能量实际上更充沛了。

sentences.en: They felt more in touch with themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们感觉自己与内心的联系更紧密了。

sentences.en: Some people are never going to get that.
sentences.zh: 有些人永远无法体会到这一点。

sentences.en: You know, the noises and the voices they hear in their head, they will never just be their own.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们脑海中听到的噪音和声音，永远不会仅仅属于他们自己。

sentences.en: Like imagine that.
sentences.zh: 想象一下吧。

sentences.en: Imagine spending your whole life never knowing what you would think or do or see or believe if no one else was there.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，你度过了一生，却永远不知道如果没有别人的存在，你会去想、去做、去看、去相信什么。

sentences.en: And if you solo travel, you will never have to wonder that.
sentences.zh: 如果你独自旅行，你将永远不必去猜测这一点。

sentences.en: You will never have to wonder.
sentences.zh: 你永远不必去猜想。

sentences.en: Also, just because you solo travel doesn't mean you need to solitary travel.
sentences.zh: 另外，独自旅行并不意味着你需要孤立地旅行。

sentences.en: Like there's a big distinction here between being completely solitary and isolated and just going into the trip alone.
sentences.zh: 这其中有很大的区别：完全孤立和隔绝，与只是独自踏上旅程是两码事。

sentences.en: So book a group tour for a day.
sentences.zh: 所以，可以预定一日拼团游。

sentences.en: Stay in a social hostel.
sentences.zh: 住在社交氛围浓厚的青旅。

sentences.en: Well, even if you have your own room or you're in a smaller bunk space, you could travel with someone that you meet for a few days and then leave them at your next destination.
sentences.zh: 嗯，即使你有自己的房间或者住在小一点的铺位空间里，你也可以和你在路上遇到的人一起旅行几天，然后在下一站告别。

sentences.en: So don't fall into the trap of believing that the purpose of this trip is to be isolated.
sentences.zh: 所以，不要陷入这种陷阱，以为这次旅行的目的是为了孤立自己。

sentences.en: It's definitely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对不是这样的。

sentences.en: It's just to be self-directed.
sentences.zh: 目的只是为了自主掌控。

sentences.en: I also find that people who start travel Instagrams, love that.
sentences.zh: 我也发现那些开启旅行Instagram账号的人，非常喜欢这样。

sentences.en: Love that for them.
sentences.zh: 非常为他们感到高兴。

sentences.en: I love seeing people's like photo dumps of where they are.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢看别人晒出他们所在地方的照片集。

sentences.en: And when you're a solo traveler, it means that you do still feel connected to people back home.
sentences.zh: 当你是一个独自旅行者时，这意味着你确实仍然与国内的人保持着联系。

sentences.en: You don't feel like people are forgetting about you.
sentences.zh: 你不会觉得别人已经把你遗忘了。

sentences.en: You don't feel as lonely.
sentences.zh: 你不会觉得那么孤独。

sentences.en: You can still have that kind of ongoing communication with people about what you are experiencing, what you are learning.
sentences.zh: 你仍然可以与大家保持这种持续的交流，分享你的经历和见闻。

sentences.en: Another big thing that we face that I don't actually hear talked about a lot is decision fatigue.
sentences.zh: 我们面临的另一个重大问题，是我其实很少听到别人谈论的，那就是决策疲劳。

sentences.en: Making every single choice for yourself every single day from, you know, what am I going to eat?
sentences.zh: 每天都要为自己做出每一个决定，从“我要吃什么？”，

sentences.en: What sights am I going to see?
sentences.zh: “我要去看什么景点？”，

sentences.en: Where am I going to stay?
sentences.zh: “我要住哪里？”，

sentences.en: How am I going to get there?
sentences.zh: “我要怎么去那里？”。

sentences.en: That can be exhausting.
sentences.zh: 这会让人筋疲力尽。

sentences.en: And solo travelers often face more decisions, not just logistical decisions, but also spontaneous decisions day in and day out.
sentences.zh: 独自旅行者经常要面对更多的决定，不仅是后勤方面的决定，还有日复一日的即兴决定。

sentences.en: So our cognitive capacity for making decisions is actually rather limited.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们用于做决定的认知能力其实相当有限。

sentences.en: Each choice you are going to make, no matter how small, it does deplete your mental energy.
sentences.zh: 你做出的每一个选择，无论多小，都会消耗你的精神能量。

sentences.en: And what's more is that, you know, everyday environment, you know, when you're at home, you make basically the same choices every day.
sentences.zh: 更何况，你知道的，在日常环境中，当你在家时，你基本上每天都在做相同的选择。

sentences.en: You take the same route home from work.
sentences.zh: 你走同一条路下班回家。

sentences.en: You have the same routine.
sentences.zh: 你有同样的作息。

sentences.en: You go to the same gym, the same cafes.
sentences.zh: 你去同一家健身房，同一家咖啡馆。

sentences.en: Everything is typically familiar.
sentences.zh: 一切通常都是熟悉的。

sentences.en: And so when you are traveling by yourself, things that we typically wouldn't have to think about, like how do I catch the train?
sentences.zh: 所以当你独自旅行时，那些我们平时根本不用思考的事情，比如我怎么坐火车？

sentences.en: How do I pay for the train?
sentences.zh: 我怎么为火车票付钱？

sentences.en: What's on the menu?
sentences.zh: 菜单上有什么？

sentences.en: You know, suddenly we have to think a little bit harder about those things.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们突然需要对这些事情多费脑筋。

sentences.en: And that is going to contribute to your cognitive overload.
sentences.zh: 这将会加重你的认知过载。

sentences.en: This can definitely make us more tired, a little bit irritable at times, anxious.
sentences.zh: 这绝对会让我们更容易疲惫，有时会有点烦躁，感到焦虑。

sentences.en: But the worst thing, the worst consequence of this, I believe at least, is that it can lead to indecision and avoidance.
sentences.zh: 但我认为最糟糕的事情，最坏的后果，至少在我看来，是它会导致优柔寡断和逃避。

sentences.en: I don't know if you've ever found yourself in this situation before at home, but you know when you just have so many options of what you could do in a day, you know, you
sentences.zh: 我不知道你在家里是否也曾发现自己处于这种境地，但你知道那种感觉吗？当你在一天里有太多事情可以选择去做，你知道的，

sentences.en: could do chores, you could see a friend, you could go to the gym, go out for dinner.
sentences.zh: 你可以做家务，可以见朋友，可以去健身房，出去吃晚饭。

sentences.en: And because you have so many options, you're just like, I just don't want to do any of them.
sentences.zh: 正因为你有太多的选择，你就会想：我什么都不想做了。

sentences.en: You know, it's not possible to decide which one would be beSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，要决定哪一个才是最好的，是不可能的。

sentences.en: So I'm just not going to make a decision at all.
sentences.zh: 所以我干脆不作任何决定了。

sentences.en: That can happen when you're traveling.
sentences.zh: 旅行时这种情况时有发生。

sentences.en: And the consequence of decision fatigue in this environment is that actually you feel quite let down.
sentences.zh: 在这种环境下，决策疲劳带来的后果其实是让你感到相当沮丧。

sentences.en: You feel like you should be seeing more.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得你应该看到更多。

sentences.en: The easiest way to counteract this is to actually do the counterintuitive thing and give yourself less choice.
sentences.zh: 对抗这种情况最简单的方法，其实是反其道而行之，给自己少一点选择。

sentences.en: I know we speak about, you know, solo traveling and talk about how it's all about freedom, but imposing some restrictions on yourself may actually mean you get more out of it.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们总在谈论独自旅行，并说这完全是为了追求自由，但对自己施加一些限制，实际上可能意味着你能从中收获更多。

sentences.en: You know, eating breakfast at the same places every day or having that breakfast spot, that's really smart because that's one decision that isn't going to overload you cognitively.
sentences.zh: 你知道，每天在同一个地方吃早餐，或者锁定那个固定的早餐店，这真的非常明智，因为这是一个不会让你产生认知过载的决定。

sentences.en: And you can use that mental energy, those resources to make a better decision.
sentences.zh: 你可以利用这种精神能量和资源来做出更好的决定。

sentences.en: The other thing that I do is that I make a list of 10 things.
sentences.zh: 我做的另一件事是列一个十项清单。

sentences.en: When I go on a trip, say the trip is two weeks long, I make a list of 10 things that I really
sentences.zh: 当我出行时，比如说行程为期两周，我会列出十件我真的

sentences.en: want to do and I make a rough itinerary that still leaves me like three to four days of having nothing scheduled.
sentences.zh: 想做的事，然后做一份粗略的行程规划，这依然能留给我大概三到四天没有任何安排的时间。

sentences.en: But during those days, I know kind of what I'm going to do.
sentences.zh: 但在那些日子里，我大概知道自己要做什么。

sentences.en: I have a loose plan and I make sure that things are in the same area.
sentences.zh: 我有一个大致的计划，并且确保这些事情都在同一个区域。

sentences.en: So once I'm out of the house, there is kind of a continuity between where I'm going and my experiences.
sentences.zh: 所以一旦我出门，我要去的地方和我的经历之间就会有一种连贯性。

sentences.en: I also think it's really important here when you're facing decision fatigue, often that comes from a sensation or a deep feeling that you need to make the perfect decision, right?
sentences.zh: 我也觉得，当你面对决策疲劳时，这一点非常重要，这种疲劳往往源于一种感觉或深层感受，即你需要做出完美的决定，对吧？

sentences.en: This is such a sacred experience.
sentences.zh: 这是一次如此神圣的经历。

sentences.en: You're solo traveling.
sentences.zh: 你在独自旅行。

sentences.en: You're in this new country.
sentences.zh: 你在这个全新的国家。

sentences.en: There's so much to do.
sentences.zh: 有那么多事情要做。

sentences.en: I don't want to miss out.
sentences.zh: 我不想错过任何东西。

sentences.en: I want to make sure that I come back with a good story.
sentences.zh: 我想确保我能带回一个精彩的故事。

sentences.en: I want to make sure that I see everything, do everything.
sentences.zh: 我想确保我能看遍一切，做尽所有事。

sentences.en: What do I do first?
sentences.zh: 我该先做什么？

sentences.en: Don't aim for perfection.
sentences.zh: 不要追求完美。

sentences.en: Even people who live in their cities, their whole lives never see half the things that you want to see.
sentences.zh: 甚至那些在一个城市生活了一辈子的人，也从未看完全部你想看的事物的的一半。

sentences.en: So just know that actually some of the best experiences do come from being quite spontaneous.
sentences.zh: 所以要知道，实际上一些最棒的体验正是源于相当随性的状态。

sentences.en: They do come from just getting out of the house with no plan or just choosing one thing to really focus on for the day.
sentences.zh: 它们确实源于毫无计划地出门，或者仅仅选择一件事在当下一心专注地去做。

sentences.en: This is not an assignment.
sentences.zh: 这不是一项作业。

sentences.en: This is not a piece of work.
sentences.zh: 这不是一份工作。

sentences.en: This is not anything that needs to be perfect for someone else to judge or for someone else to see.
sentences.zh: 这不是什么需要做到完美以供他人评判或审视的东西。

sentences.en: It's actually really fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这其实非常奇妙。

sentences.en: We talk about decision fatigue and how it can be really hard for solo travelers.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论决策疲劳，以及它对独自旅行者来说有多难。

sentences.en: But actually, when solo travelers return home, they report how difficult it is to adjust to having to consider other people.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，当独自旅行者回到家中时，他们会反映说，去适应需要顾及他人是一件多么困难的事。

sentences.en: Because you're so used to being self-directed in these environments, you come back and your family's like, let's go out for breakfaSt.
sentences.zh: 因为你太习惯在这些环境中自主决定了，你回来后，家人会说，我们出去吃早餐吧。

sentences.en: And you're like, great, we're going to go here.
sentences.zh: 然后你会说，太好了，我们要去这里。

sentences.en: And suddenly it's like, no, no, I want to go here.
sentences.zh: 而突然之间，他们会说，不，不，我想去这里。

sentences.en: I want to go there.
sentences.zh: 我想去那里。

sentences.en: And it can actually be quite frustrating for solo travelers.
sentences.zh: 这其实会让独自旅行者感到相当沮丧。

sentences.en: It's often this sense of like a shock of returning to a system or returning to a situation or an environment in which you do actually now have to consider other people again.
sentences.zh: 这通常是一种重返某个体系、某种情境或某种环境的冲击感，在这些环境中，你现在确实必须重新考虑其他人的感受。

sentences.en: So the final difficulty I think we face when contemplating solo exploring, it's a deeply human one and it's a fear of the unknown.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为我们在考虑独自探索时面临的最后一个困难，是一个极其人性化的困难，那就是对未知的恐惧。

sentences.en: And with that can come a heavy dose of catastrophizing, right?
sentences.zh: 随之而来的往往是大量的灾难化想象，对吧？

sentences.en: This is the biggest thing that I think people bring up when you say, you should solo travel.
sentences.zh: 每当你说“你应该独自旅行，独自旅行太值得了”时，这绝对是人们最常提出的问题。

sentences.en: Solo travel is so worthwhile.
sentences.zh: 独自旅行太值得了。

sentences.en: It's what if I'm kidnapped?
sentences.zh: 万一我被绑架了呢？

sentences.en: What if I get lost?
sentences.zh: 万一我迷路了呢？

sentences.en: What if I get robbed?
sentences.zh: 万一我被抢劫了呢？

sentences.en: What if something terrible happens?
sentences.zh: 万一发生什么可怕的事呢？

sentences.en: What if no one knows where I am?
sentences.zh: 万一没人知道我在哪里呢？

sentences.en: Our brain takes the unknown and it likes to make a mess of it, likes to make it its little fantasy playground of all the worst things possible that our brain can conjure up.
sentences.zh: 我们的大脑面对未知时，喜欢把它搞得一团糟，喜欢把它变成它的小小幻想游乐场，里面充斥着大脑能想到的所有最糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: That is anxiety.
sentences.zh: 这就是焦虑。

sentences.en: That is a survival mechanism.
sentences.zh: 这是一种生存机制。

sentences.en: It is not the truth.
sentences.zh: 它并非事实。

sentences.en: I want you to remember, though, it is a very valid concern.
sentences.zh: 不过我想让你记住，这是一个非常合理的担忧。

sentences.en: Safety is a valid concern.
sentences.zh: 安全是一个合理的担忧。

sentences.en: But everything in life is a risk.
sentences.zh: 但生活中的一切都是一种风险。

sentences.en: There is fear embedded in everything that we do, even getting out of bed, even walking out of our front door.
sentences.zh: 我们所做的每一件事都伴随着恐惧，甚至连起床、甚至连走自家前门也是如此。

sentences.en: Well, you, though, you were not put on this earth to play it safe and you were not put
sentences.zh: 然而，你来到这个世上可不是为了求稳，你来到

sentences.en: on this earth to only go where it's comfortable, because that would mean that you really never grow.
sentences.zh: 这个世上也不是为了只去那些舒适的地方，因为那意味着你真的永远不会成长。

sentences.en: You never move from where you are now.
sentences.zh: 你永远不会超越现有的状态。

sentences.en: Things can go wrong.
sentences.zh: 事情可能会出错。

sentences.en: They do go wrong.
sentences.zh: 它们确实会出错。

sentences.en: But when you have your wits about you, when you do the common sense things, you still are a lot more capable than you know.
sentences.zh: 但当你保持清醒的头脑，当你去做那些常识性的事情时，你依然比自己想象的要能干得多。

sentences.en: And the very nature of solo traveling is to show you that you know what you're doing, that you are capable, strong, independent.
sentences.zh: 独自旅行的本质，就是向你证明你知道自己在做什么，证明你是有能力、坚强且独立的。

sentences.en: You have that mental toughness.
sentences.zh: 你拥有那种心理韧性。

sentences.en: You have that adaptability, that flexibility.
sentences.zh: 你拥有那种适应力和灵活性。

sentences.en: So those experiences and the thought of those experiences can be scary.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些经历以及对这些经历的联想可能会让人感到害怕。

sentences.en: But firstly, you're very unlikely to encounter them.
sentences.zh: 但首先，你不太可能会遇到它们。

sentences.en: Secondly, when you do, you will realize that you are a lot more capable in that moment.
sentences.zh: 其次，当你真正遇到时，你会发现在那一刻自己要能干得多。

sentences.en: It's not as scary as you thought it would be.
sentences.zh: 它并没有你想象的那么可怕。

sentences.en: And I think finally, when you have common sense, when you just do basic safety things like having an anti-pickpocket bag, registering with your embassy, telling people where you're
sentences.zh: 我想最后要说的是，当你具备常识，当你只是去做一些基本的安全防范，比如背一个防偷包、向你的大使馆登记、告诉别人你要

sentences.en: going, a lot of that risk is definitely minimized.
sentences.zh: 去哪里，很大一部分风险绝对会被降到最低。

sentences.en: So I want to finish up with just some general advice, some fast, rapid fire tips from me to you, but also from some of the audience, some of the listeners who are solo traveler
sentences.zh: 所以我想用一些普遍的建议、一些我给你们的快速连珠炮式的建议来作为结尾，这些建议也来自一些观众，来自那些独自旅行的

sentences.en: pros.
sentences.zh: 专家听众。

sentences.en: This piece of advice, I believe in 100%, it's to set intentions, not expectations.
sentences.zh: 这个建议我百分之百坚信，那就是：设定意图，而非期待。

sentences.en: When you have really high expectations for something, you are always going to be disappointed,
sentences.zh: 当你对某事抱有极高的期待时，你注定会失望，

sentences.en: not because the experiences are better or worse, but because your expectations tint your perspective.
sentences.zh: 这倒不是因为经历本身更好或更糟，而是因为你的期待会给你的视角染上颜色。

sentences.en: They tint how you see things.
sentences.zh: 它们会给你的所见所闻涂上主观色彩。

sentences.en: So focus on what you're hoping to learn, what you're hoping to experience, what you're hoping
sentences.zh: 所以，与其死板地规划每一个细节，

sentences.en: to get out of it emotionally and psychologically, rather than rigidly planning every detail
sentences.zh: 纠结于诸如“既然我在巴黎，我就必须去埃菲尔铁塔，我必须看它亮灯，因为那是我的心愿单之一，它将是美丽而神奇的，一切都必须完美”这样的想法，不如去关注你希望学到什么、你希望体验什么、你希望在情感和心理上从中收获什么

sentences.en: and being like, you know, if you're in Paris, like I have to go to the Eiffel Tower and I have to see it lit up because that's on my bucket list and it's going to be beautiful
sentences.zh: 纠结于诸如“既然我在巴黎，我就必须去埃菲尔铁塔，我必须看它亮灯，因为那是我的心愿单之一，它将是美丽而神奇的，一切都必须完美”这样的想法，不如去关注你希望学到什么、你希望体验什么、你希望在情感和心理上从中收获什么

sentences.en: and magical and everything needs to be perfect.
sentences.zh: 一切都必须完美。

sentences.en: Your expectations are too high.
sentences.zh: 你的期待太高了。

sentences.en: Set them low.
sentences.zh: 把期待降低。

sentences.en: Be like, I just want to have a nice time.
sentences.zh: 告诉自己：我只想过一段美好的时光。

sentences.en: I want to have a nice meal.
sentences.zh: 我想吃一顿美餐。

sentences.en: I want to meet some new people.
sentences.zh: 我想结识一些新朋友。

sentences.en: I want to walk around.
sentences.zh: 我想四处走走。

sentences.en: I want to see a sunset.
sentences.zh: 我想看一场日落。

sentences.en: More general ideas of what the trip could be.
sentences.zh: 对旅行应该是什么样，抱持更广泛、更通用的想法。

sentences.en: So don't plan everything.
sentences.zh: 所以不要把一切都计划好。

sentences.en: Remember that you have freedom.
sentences.zh: 记住你拥有自由。

sentences.en: So if you're not enjoying where you are, if you're not enjoying your accommodation, you're not enjoying the country, the city, the suburb, the neighborhood that you're in, move on.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你不喜欢你所在的地方，如果你不喜欢你的住处，不喜欢你所在的国家、城市、郊区或街区，那就离开。

sentences.en: You don't have to ask anyone for permission.
sentences.zh: 你不需要征求任何人的同意。

sentences.en: That's the beauty of this.
sentences.zh: 这就是它的美妙之处。

sentences.en: If you are not having fun, just leave.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得不好玩，那就走开。

sentences.en: And I always say this, you know, it can be hard when you've already paid for a hotel, you've paid for an experience.
sentences.zh: 我总是这么说，你知道的，当你已经为一家酒店、为一次体验付过钱时，这可能会很难。

sentences.en: This is what I always say.
sentences.zh: 这就是我常说的话。

sentences.en: You can either waste your money and do something else or you can waste your money and your time.
sentences.zh: 要么你白白浪费了钱然后去做别的事，要么你既浪费了钱又浪费了时间。

sentences.en: And that is the double whammy.
sentences.zh: 这才是双重打击。

sentences.en: You can waste your money while, you know, you're still doing an experience.
sentences.zh: 你可以一边浪费钱，一边，你知道的，还在继续那种体验。

sentences.en: You're still staying somewhere you don't enjoy and you've already spent the money on the thing.
sentences.zh: 你依然待在一个你不喜欢的地方，而且你已经在上面花过钱了。

sentences.en: But then you're also wasting your time because you could have been using those hours, those days to be somewhere else, somewhere better, somewhere that you may have enjoyed more.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时你也在浪费时间，因为你本可以用那些时间、那些日子去别的地方，去更好的地方，去一个你可能会更喜欢的地方。

sentences.en: Rest, please, take a break.
sentences.zh: 休息，求你了，休息一下。

sentences.en: I did an episode, I think at the start of the year on travel burnout for people who solo travel a lot.
sentences.zh: 我想在今年年初时，我做过一期关于旅行倦怠的节目，针对的是那些经常独自旅行的人。

sentences.en: It's a real thing.
sentences.zh: 这是真实存在的。

sentences.en: You know, you put a lot of pressure on yourself to be go, go, go.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你给自己施加了很大的压力，要求自己必须马不停蹄、连轴转。

sentences.en: You've spent all this money.
sentences.zh: 你花了这么多钱。

sentences.en: You want to see everything, do everything, taste everything.
sentences.zh: 你想看遍一切、做尽所有事、尝遍所有美食。

sentences.en: It sounds strange.
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能有点奇怪。

sentences.en: Rest will make those experiences better.
sentences.zh: 休息会让那些体验变得更好。

sentences.en: If you, my general rule is that for every four days that you are doing something, take one day to do nothing.
sentences.zh: 如果你——我的普遍原则是，每连续做四天的事，就抽一天什么也不做。

sentences.en: Take one day or even a half day to just walk around, take it easy, have a nice meal, have a sleep in.
sentences.zh: 抽出一整天甚至半天时间到处走走、放轻松、吃顿大餐、睡个懒觉。

sentences.en: It will really mean that you get more out of the trip.
sentences.zh: 这真的意味着你能从旅行中收获更多。

sentences.en: And finally, bring a journal along and try and do an entry every night or every morning, reflecting on the previous experiences.
sentences.zh: 最后，带上一本手帐，试着每天晚上或每天早晨写一篇日记，反思一下之前的经历。

sentences.en: This is a really great way to see how you're growing, to remember the realizations that you're having when you get home.
sentences.zh: 这是了解自己如何成长、记住回家后那些顿悟时刻的绝佳方式。

sentences.en: It's also just a great historical document to have the older you get.
sentences.zh: 随着你年纪越来越大，这也是一份极好的历史文献。

sentences.en: I think about this all the time.
sentences.zh: 我无时无刻不在想这件事。

sentences.en: You know, my kids being able to read what I've written, a museum getting a hold of it,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我的孩子能够阅读我写下的文字，博物馆会收藏它，

sentences.en: maybe some future human finding it tucked into a drawer of some antique piece of furniture that's probably from Ikea, but they don't know that.
sentences.zh: 也许未来某个人会在某件古董家具的抽屉缝里发现它——那件家具大概是宜家的，但他们并不知道。

sentences.en: Like, I really like that idea of the memories that I've had taking on some permanence.
sentences.zh: 真的，我很喜欢这种让我的过往回忆获得某种永恒感的想法。

sentences.en: So I would really encourage you to get a really nice journal and use it.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的鼓励你们去买一本非常漂亮的日记本并把它用起来。

sentences.en: I hope that you've enjoyed this episode.
sentences.zh: 希望你们会喜欢这一期节目。

sentences.en: I hope that I've made a compelling argument for solo traveling in your 20s and also given you a bit of a pep talk if you are someone who solo travels on what to do on those hard days,
sentences.zh: 希望我刚才为二十多岁时的独自旅行给出了一个令人信服的理由，同时也为你如果是一个独自旅行者、却不知在那些艰难的日子里该怎么做、为什么这一切到头来都值得、以及如何提升旅行体验时，提供了一些鼓励的话语。

sentences.en: why it's all worth it at the end, how to elevate the experience.
sentences.zh: 为什么这一切到头来都值得，如何提升体验。

sentences.en: It genuinely is something that I deeply believe that we should all do, even if it's just going on a camping trip two hours away from home.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一件我深信我们都应该去做的事，哪怕只是去进行一次离家两小时的露营。

sentences.en: It's accessible and available to everyone, hopefully in some capacity.
sentences.zh: 它对每个人都是触手可及的，并以某种形式向所有人开放。

sentences.en: As always, if you enjoyed this episode, make sure that you leave a comment, you leave a review, hopefully a five star review, if you would be so kind.
sentences.zh: 一如既往，如果你喜欢这期节目，请务必留下评论，留下你的评价，如果你能大发慈悲的话，最好留下一个五星好评。

sentences.en: I do read everything that you guys say.
sentences.zh: 我确实会阅读你们大家留下的每一句话。

sentences.en: It makes my day.
sentences.zh: 这让我一整天都心情大好。

sentences.en: I spend like a couple of minutes or like 20 minutes every day just reading through the new reviews, reading through the comments you guys are leaving on Spotify.
sentences.zh: 我每天都会花几分钟或大概二十分钟来浏览新的评价，阅读你们在Spotify上留下的评论。

sentences.en: So thank you to all of you who are giving feedback, telling us what you think.
sentences.zh: 所以非常感谢所有提供反馈、告诉我们你们想法的人。

sentences.en: Make sure you are also following us on Instagram at that psychology podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 请务必在Instagram上关注我们，账号是that psychology podcast。

sentences.en: You can learn more about the topics that we talk about on the show.
sentences.zh: 你可以了解更多我们在节目中讨论过的话题。

sentences.en: We go more in depth.
sentences.zh: 我们会进行更深入的探讨。

sentences.en: We talk about some of the studies and I give you the options to choose new episodes, to give your input, to talk about your experiences.
sentences.zh: 我们会讨论一些相关研究，我还会给大家提供选择新节目的选项、发表意见的机会以及谈论你们自身经历的空间。

sentences.en: So we would love to see you over there.
sentences.zh: 所以我们很期待在那里见到你们。

sentences.en: And until next time, stay safe, stay kind and please be gentle to yourself.
sentences.zh: 直到下一次，注意安全，保持善良，请对你自己温柔一点。

sentences.en: We will talk very, very soon.
sentences.zh: 我们很快就会再聊。

sentences.zh: 这是一档iHeart播客。

sentences.zh: 纯人工创作。
